newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch development minister to tour EU capitals.
newsitem.headline: Dutch development minister to tour EU capitals.

text.p: Dutch Development Cooperation Minister Jan Pronk will on Thursday start a mini-tour of European capitals to discuss key issues that will come up during the Netherlands' six-month European Union presidency.
Pronk will call on Luxembourg on Thursday, Portugal and Spain on Monday and Austria on Tuesday and visit other EU capitals later this year, the ministry said on Wednesday.

The Dutch have said their aim is to get a cohesive EU policy on developing countries, drawing together issues that come under three different EU councils -- food security and fisheries; conflict management and migration.
Pronk will also want to glean member states' views on EU relations with the African, Caribbean and Pacific (ACP) nations under the Lome Convention.
As part of the tour, Pronk will also hold bilateral talks with the former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia and will visit United Nations agencies in Geneva.
